Kids party entertainment and party hire in Western Australia

Western Australia covers the Perth metropolitan area from Wanneroo in the north to Mandurah in the south. Pick your area to see who genuinely covers it.

Get free quotes All Australian locations

Kids Party House covers nine areas across Western Australia. The supplier base here is local rather than national, and service areas are taken seriously. A northern corridor operator quoting for a southern suburbs party is looking at a long run and will price it accordingly.

The north of the river and south of the river split is a genuine planning factor. So is the afternoon sea breeze, which reliably affects inflatables in coastal suburbs while leaving parties a few kilometres inland untouched.

Summer heat is severe enough that morning starts and real shade are the sensible default across the whole state rather than a precaution for the worst days.

State questions

Western Australia kids party questions

Which areas of Western Australia do you cover?

Perth, Stirling, Joondalup, Wanneroo, Swan, Canning, Cockburn, Rockingham and Mandurah. Suburbs outside those councils are matched from the nearest page.

Does the north and south of the river split really matter?

For booking, yes. Perth is spread out and suppliers are local. An operator based in Joondalup will price a Rockingham party for the seventy kilometre run. Naming your suburb means you hear from operators who genuinely cover you.

How does the sea breeze affect party bookings?

The afternoon sea breeze is strong and predictable in coastal suburbs. Inflatable operators will not install above their wind limit, so a morning booking or an inland suburb largely removes the issue.

What time should a summer party start in WA?

Morning. December to February afternoons are severe enough that shade alone does not solve it, and castle vinyl gets uncomfortably hot in direct sun.
